_comment: AnacostiaIQ configuration. Edit this file to add/repin sensors, choose a weather source, or change app settings — no recompile needed. GPIO pins are BCM line offsets. Each sensor (and weather) may set its own 'intervalSeconds'; omit it to use app.pollIntervalSeconds. Each sensor may also set 'samplesPerReading': one reported reading is then the mean of that many samples taken back to back (failed samples are dropped, and 60 ms separates consecutive ones). Omit it for 1, i.e. no averaging. Raising it lengthens the blocking read proportionally, so keep intervalSeconds well above samplesPerReading x the time one sample takes.

health._comment: Operational health thresholds. Defaults preserve the original behavior; edit these values without recompiling the service.

adaptive._comment: When no forecast point in the next 'lookaheadHours' exceeds 'rainProbabilityThreshold' percent, every sensor's intervalSeconds is multiplied by 'idleFactor' (low-frequency mode). Rain in the forecast restores the base intervals. The weather poll itself is never scaled — it's what notices rain returning. Set enabled=false to pin the base intervals, or idleFactor=1 for the same effect.

weather._comment: source is 'openmeteo' or 'noaa'. Open-Meteo uses latitude/longitude and gives hourly values. NOAA uses noaaOffice + gridX/gridY (multi-hour bins). 'intervalSeconds' polls weather as a group; forecasts change slowly so a larger value is fine.

ads1115._comment: LAB PI ONLY: ADS1115 soil-moisture ADC on I2C bus 1. GPIO2/GPIO3 remain SDA1/SCL1; unlike the retired ADC0804 lab path this block does not claim GPIO2 as a general-purpose output. Initial calibration measured 2026-09-17: dry air about 17155 raw (2.144 V), wet endpoint about 6400 raw (0.800 V). Recalibrate adcWet in representative soil for quantitative use.

sensors._comment: HC-SR04, per HC_SR04_ultrasonic_sensor_4/main.cpp: TRIG on GPIO17 (header pin 11), ECHO on GPIO18 (header pin 12). TRIG was previously GPIO15, which collides with UART0 RXD that the MB7389-100 entry below needs — GPIO17 is free in this pin map. Rewire TRIG from header pin 10 to header pin 11 on the Pi to match. Published with lab-specific ID lab_hcsr04_depth so cloud data cannot mix with the field station.
sensors.name: Inflow Weir Head

sensors._comment: LAB PI ONLY: soil-moisture probe analog output is wired to ADS1115 A0. Initial calibration from bench test on 2026-09-17: dry air ~17155 raw; wet endpoint ~6400 raw. MoistureSensorI2C maps dry to 0% and wet to 100% and clamps outside that range. Published with lab-specific ID lab_moisture_a0 so cloud data cannot mix with the field station.
sensors.name: Soil Moisture

sensors._comment: ENABLED — the original CUA lab MB7389-100 uses an active 2N3904 inverter with a 3.3-V pull-up between sensor pin 5 and GPIO15 (header pin 10). Raw /dev/ttyAMA0 capture verified valid R#### carriage-return frames after installation. This original lab unit free-runs, so do not add triggerPin to this entry. The new MB7389-100 is a separate sensor on UART2 in the following entry. Published with lab-specific ID lab_maxbotix_depth_1 so cloud data cannot mix with the field station.
sensors.name: MB7389-100 Depth

sensors._comment: LAB PI NEW MB7389-100 (label B7604): powered from 3.3 V, sensor pin 5 TTL serial wired directly to GPIO5 / UART2 RX (physical pin 29), and pin 4 left open for continuous ranging. Requires dtoverlay=uart2-pi5 and /dev/ttyAMA2. This is separate from the installed inverted-polarity unit on /dev/ttyAMA0. Published with lab-specific ID lab_maxbotix_depth_2 so cloud data cannot mix with the field station.
sensors.name: New MB7389-100 Depth

weirFlow._comment: Derived V-notch inflow flow. The lab_hcsr04_depth sensor reports head as params.totalLength (sensor-to-crest distance) minus measured range. Keep disabled until the field weir drawing supplies the surveyed sensor-to-crest distance and notch angle, Cd is selected/calibrated, and a defensible minimumHead is set. minimumHead uses the same unit as lab_hcsr04_depth. When enabled, values below minimumHead are withheld rather than reported as zero.
